newsitem.title: USA: Lindsey-no sign price rises being passed along.
newsitem.headline: Lindsey-no sign price rises being passed along.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey on Wednesday said there were no signs so far that businesses were attempting to pass on price increases to consumers.
"So far we don't see it in the data yet," Lindsey told reporters after speaking to a conference on small business sponsored by the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond.
Asked the extent to which businesses were facing tight labor markets, Lindsey said, "You're reading the same stories I'm reading. It is a challenge finding qualified labor."
Lindsey was also questioned about the extent to which the economy was showing signs of slowing after robust growth in the second quarter. He said it was difficult to make predictions.
